name: Shio Taiou na Valentine Suru Dake
original_name: 塩対応なバレンタインするだけ
source:
A short romance(?) game where you don't end up with anyone. 

Even though there are a lot of guys you interested in, you aren't good at making sweets, so you only been able to prepare one Valentine's chocolate! And what's more, none of them have any feelings for me!!!
translation:
一款简短的浪漫（？）游戏，你最终不会和任何人在一起。

虽然你感兴趣的男人很多，但你不擅长做甜点，所以你只能准备一颗情人节巧克力！更重要的是，他们都对我没有任何感情！
